scripts.title: Novice Hub
scripts.features:
Novice Hub GUI offers plenty of autofarm options.
- Auto buy all buttons
- Auto complete obbies for bonuses
- Auto open factory door
- Auto load gum
- Auto collect tree gumballs
- Auto place ascender upgrader (Ascended players only)

- Change ball size (fun)
- Delete doors

    end
    return OldNameCall(self,...)
end))
